stepBody:
Evaluation Robustness: The validation accuracy of Connie's model is extremely unstable, with each run producing wildly different numbers. She is rightfully concerned but doesn't know how to fix this. What should she do?

• Retrain with more data in the training set allocated to the validation set.
• Retrain with more data in the validation set allocated to the training set.
• Add more features to the dataset, to increase model complexity.
• Use cross-validation.
choices: Retrain with more data in the training set allocated to the validation set.
Retrain with more data in the validation set allocated to the training set.
Add more features to the dataset, to increase model complexity.
